root_cause: Netlify API-source deploys can have deploy metadata commit_ref=null and omit COMMIT_REF/HEAD during the build. The final release-evidence step required those provider variables, so an otherwise valid API-source build exited with code 2.
prevention_rule: Stamp the exact GitHub SHA into .bg-source-commit before API-source upload. Release evidence may use that marker only when it is exactly 40 hex; if provider env and marker both exist they must match. Production deploy remains explicit workflow_dispatch deploy=true only.
evidence: Netlify deploy 6ab254dd2116c8947f08bf50 was terminal error with deploy_source=api, has_source_zip=true, commit_ref=null and build exit code 2.
tools/bouw-release-evidence.mjs required COMMIT_REF/HEAD before this fix.
The failed canonical workflow run 35714761271 used exact source e88be69fd853515cb1336af8fe80cd4a068b6f98 and its transport step succeeded before the provider build failed.
terminal_rule: LIVE_BEWEZEN only after protected merge, a fresh explicit deploy=true run on then-current main, Netlify state ready, release.json exact SHA/context/deploy_id, and public blog content readback.
